summary: SaloneHCM iteration 4 (AI Action Mode + CSV writer + context ids) — Backend 40/40 pytest tests PASSED (11 new in test_iter4_action_mode.py covering context id= prefix, action_mode admin/employee, multi-step plan execution, employee 403, empty steps 400, unknown step skipped, per-step error isolation, CSV escaping with commas in name + bank_name; plus 29 regressions). Frontend Playwright: admin sees both 'Use company data' (forest green) + 'Action mode' (terracotta) toggles; employee sees neither. Action mode toggle correctly forces context ON (verified 'Use company data · ON' after clicking Action mode). User message shows 'ACTION REQUEST' badge. AI returns parseable plan — orange-bordered 'PROPOSED ACTION PLAN' card renders with title, rationale, numbered steps, Cancel + Confirm buttons. Cancel removes plan card (replaced with 'Plan cancelled.'). Confirm executes via /api/assistant/action/execute and renders ✓ green per-step status with summary 'Plan executed — 1 of 1 steps succeeded.' ui_bugs.issue: After clicking Cancel, the parent assistant message still displays the raw ```json``` fenced block as plain text (because cleanContent() only strips the fence when m.plan is truthy; once plan is set to null on cancel the fence reappears). Cosmetic — the JSON dump leaks into the chat transcript after cancel. Fix: gate cleanContent on (m.plan || m.cancelled).
Carry-over from iter2 — width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings still appear on first paint. Charts render correctly. Acceptable per problem statement.

action_items: Minor: in Assistant.jsx line 170, change `cleanContent` to also strip fence when m.cancelled is true so cancelled plan messages don't display raw JSON.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1004 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. URGENT: split into routers/ modules (auth.py, employees.py, payroll.py, leave.py, audit.py, assistant.py, pdf.py). The monolithic server.py is hard to maintain and increases collision risk on next iteration.

/api/assistant/action/execute payroll_run step duplicates the entire payroll engine logic from /api/payroll/run — extract a shared async function `_run_payroll(year, month, user, audit_action_prefix='')` and reuse from both endpoints to satisfy DRY.

_extract_plan() regex is non-greedy and only matches the first ```json``` block. If the AI emits multiple fenced blocks (e.g., one example + one real plan), it picks the example. Consider extracting all blocks and picking the last/largest valid one.

ActionPlanIn.plan is typed as `dict` (no Pydantic validation of steps shape). Consider a typed PlanModel with discriminated step union for better validation and to surface bad payloads as 422 instead of generic per-step errors.
execute_plan does not enforce a max-steps cap — a malicious or hallucinated plan with 1000 steps would all execute serially. Add `if len(steps) > 50: raise HTTPException(400, ...)`.

Audit logging for action plan steps does not include the original session_id or the user-confirmed plan title for non-leave steps — makes forensic correlation harder. Consider attaching plan title + session_id to every meta dict.
csv.writer fix verified — commas in bank_name and beneficiary now correctly quoted/escaped (parseable with csv.reader).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (1 cosmetic nit on cancel)

seed_data_creation: test_iter4_action_mode.py creates a TEST_iter4 employee with comma in name+bank_name for CSV escaping test (deleted on teardown), one pending leave per run for multi-step execution test, one payroll run via AI plan, one attendance entry, and one AI-created leave. test_iter2_exports.py minor fix: rstrip('\r') on CSV lines (csv.writer emits CRLF per RFC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 fully validated end-to-end (backend + frontend + integration). data-testid coverage on Assistant: assistant-page, assistant-context-toggle, assistant-action-toggle, assistant-input, assistant-send, assistant-messages, action-plan, plan-cancel, plan-confirm. Audit log records ai_* prefixed actions for AI-executed steps. Bank-file CSV uses csv.writer with QUOTE_MINIMAL and CRLF line endings (RFC 4180). The only outstanding UX nit is the leftover JSON fence on cancelled plans (LOW priority). server.py is 1004 lines — strongly recommend splitting before iteration 5.
rca of the issue: Cancel raw-JSON leak RCA: cleanContent() conditional only checks m.plan; on cancel, m.plan is set to null so the regex stripping branch is never taken and the original assistant text (which still contains the ```json``` fence from the AI reply) renders verbatim. Fix: `const cleanContent = (m) => ((m.plan || m.cancelled) ? m.content.replace(/```(?:json)?\s*\{[\s\S]*?\}\s*```/g, '').trim() : m.content);`
